name: Lyla
source:
"I'll be living with you for a while, so you should feel honored to be milked by me ♪"

An entity created to free the Maou from his seal. For all intents and purposes, she is the Maou's daughter. She is cunning and self-centered.

She has an older sister who was also created by the Maou.

She is gathering high-quality magical power in order to revive the sealed Maou. She appears before the protagonist to obtain the protagonist's magical semen, which has the finest-quality magical power.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/102yojouhan/character01.html]official website[/url]]
